semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company supplies materials and components relevant to the semiconductor and PCB industries.
summary: Jim & Steve Industrial Co., Ltd. is a supplier of materials and components for the semiconductor and PCB industries, focusing on engineering plastics and various pumps. They have experience in the optoelectronics sector and provide clean room materials and equipment.
capabilities: Electronic grade pneumatic double diaphragm pumps (DELLMECO)
PFA bottles and Teflon valve materials (MARUICHI FUJII)

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is an important supplier to the Taiwan PCB industry.
regional_presence.Japan: They have manufacturing experience in Japan, particularly in photoelectrics.
